title: v18: Studio's remaining flow value slots stop inserting or prescribing a `{var}` token: loop/map `collection`, CRUD `filter` operands, notify `sourceId` / `templateData`, http `body`, screen `recordId` / `fields[].defaultValue` (split from objectui#12101)
body:
Filing gate: split of objectui#12101, under that dispatch's stop condition. Filed by objectui `domain:ui` seat 2 (seat post objectui#9771) · `baozhoutao` · session `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`, while reviewing PR #12371. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Why

PR #12371 converts the S1 value maps (subflow `input`, script `inputs`) plus the sites carried on objectui#12101 (screen `defaults`, notify `actionUrl`, http `url` / `headers`). Its dev measured every other site in that card's thread against the installed `@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.0`. The installed spec refuses `{x}` at each of the sites below, and `FLOW_NODE_EXPRESSION_PATHS` carries each one as a `value` row. They were held only because one PR would otherwise have grown too large. Studio still inserts or prescribes a single-brace token at each of them, so it authors a value the installed spec refuses.

## Sites (read at PR #12371's head `ec448f2`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-node-config.ts`)

| Site | Studio today | Spec row on next.0 |
|---|---|---|
| loop `collection` (S3) | `:701`, `expression`, placeholder `'{leadList}'`, `refMode: 'template'` | value; a `{x}` and a bare string are refused |
| map `collection` (S3) | `:717`, placeholder `'{items}'`, `refMode: 'template'` | value; same |
| update / delete / get_record `filter` operands (S6) | `:730` / `:735` / `:739`; `:730`'s help reads `id → {recordId}` | value (`filterOperands`) |
| notify `sourceId`, `templateData.*` (S4) | text picker | value |
| http `body` (S5) | `:766`, a single-brace picker, help "JSON or expression" | value |
| screen `recordId`, `fields[].defaultValue` | text picker | value |

Re-check: `grep -n -E "leadList|\{items\}|\{recordId\}|cfg\('body'" packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-node-config.ts` on `origin/main` once PR #12371 lands.

## Direction

The same shape PR #12371 uses (ADR-0032 Decisions 2 and 3), with ⛔ no new mode:
- Each value position authors a literal or a CEL value envelope `{ dialect: 'cel', source }`. The expression picker inserts a bare reference.
- No `{var}` insertion, and no placeholder or help text that teaches `{var}`.
- A stored single-brace token shows the spec's refusal, which names its CEL spelling.
- Measure each site on the installed spec first. A site whose prescribed spelling differs from the table above is reported, not forced.

## Overlap

objectui#12329 (S7, `pm:on-hold`, blocked by objectstack-ai/objectstack#19939) also names the `collection` placeholders, together with `json-schema-to-fields.ts` and the simulator's interpolator. This card takes the `collection` placeholders now, because the installed spec already refuses `{x}` there. objectui#12329 keeps the simulator, `json-schema-to-fields.ts` and the description prose.

`Clause-②: no`: Studio stops producing spellings the installed spec refuses. No `@object-ui/*` export moves.

**Dedupe**, run 2026-10-14 with MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included:
- `flow designer single-brace token value slot CEL envelope filter operands notify sourceId http body screen defaultValue collection` → 5 hits.
- `Studio flow inspector refuses {var} CRUD filter http body notify templateData envelope` → 8 hits.

Neither query found a duplicate. The nearest are objectui#12101 (this card's parent) and objectui#7588 (the precedent, closed).

Dedupe words: flow collection envelope; CRUD filter operand envelope; http body value slot; notify sourceId envelope.
